transcript: Speaker A: A for Apple, B for Ball jaisi English toh seekh li. Lekin aaj tak English mein dhang se sentence tak nahi bol paate ho. Aise toh tumhari koi izzat nahi karega. Isse accha tum aaj ke aaj is app pe roz sirf 15 minute English practice karke dekho. Dekhna fir kaise farratedar English bolte ho. Is app ko English Seekho app kehte hain. Yahan sirf sikhane wali videos aate hain, koi ads nahi aate. English Seekho app pe spoken English yaani bolne wali angrezi ka ek show aata hai. Experts chote-chote videos mein step-by-step English bolna sikhate hain. Toh bas roz ka 15 minute nikalo, expert ke videos dekho, AI coach se practice karo. Trial sirf ek rupaye ka hai. Fir dekhna kuch hi dino mein tumhari English dekh ke log dang reh jayenge. [You learned basic English like 'A for Apple, B for Ball', but still cannot speak proper sentences. No one will respect you this way. Instead, practice for 15 minutes daily on this app to speak fluently. This is the English Seekho app, featuring ad-free expert videos and step-by-step spoken English lessons. Practice with an AI coach; the trial is just 1 rupee. Soon, everyone will be amazed by your English.] Speaker B: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho [Learn English], INSTALL NOW, Disclaimer [Disclaimer]
summary: A presenter in a graduation gown warns that poor English skills lead to a lack of social respect. She promotes the 'English Seekho' app, highlighting its ad-free expert videos, AI coaching, and a 1-rupee trial. The ad concludes with a call to action to download the app.
